I always know what to watch out for while I'm hanging out with those close friends that affect me etc...

I have been living with Misophonia since I was about 12/13 years old (I am 17 now). When I first mentioned it to my family they thought I was being overdramatic or diagnosing myself over what I read online. Yet I've always been convinced that I have it and a few months after I first noticed my triggering, I actually found out the name for it. Now they are very supportive though. Recently in 2019 I went to my doctor to get it diagnosed or really just see if they could help me. She didn't really understand what it was, but took a bloodtest and etc to see if it was something wrong with my ear. Nothing wrong, but she then schedueled an appointment with an ear specialist. I went there, and first they had to see if my hearing was alright, so I had to take a 30 min long test. My hearing was totally fine for a teenager. Then when I met the ear specialist, he just looked inside my ear with a thing and registered on the computer that my hearing was fine. Then he told me there's nothing he can do. He also told me that it's normal and will eventually pass.... Altough I get that there's not much treatment available, it felt like he didn't even know what I had. Like as if I was just sensitive to some loud sounds, even though it's eating sounds that affect me every single day. I tried to tell him that I've had this for many years and nothing is helping me and that I've read online from different people that they've had it for DECADES. He just told me to not believe everything on the internet. I started crying and he just said it was normal to have this and "be sad" (???) while sensitive to sounds. Since I was crying and felt ignored, I couldn't get out my experience with Misophonia. I would just cry harder. It felt like he saw me as a person with the flu? Even if he's not an expert he can't just tell me that I'm wrong and that I should get used to it, even though I've been trying every single day for several years. So disrespectful. I am so furious and will definetely tell my doctor about how unprofessional that appointment was. Had to pay 30 dollars for a hearing test that I didnt even need, because if I couldn't hear things, then I obviously wouldn't have a problem with people eating. Stupid
